# 3. Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters

[LeetCode](https://leetcode.com/problems/longest-substring-without-repeating-characters/) · **Medium** · Pattern: [Sliding Window](README.md) · [All patterns](../README.md) · [Home](../../README.md)

> **Key insight:** Track each char's last index; when a repeat is inside the window, jump left past it.

## Approach

1. Track each char's last index; when a repeat is inside the window, jump left past it.
2. Complexity: time `O(n)`, space `O(min(n, alphabet))`.

| | Complexity |
|---|---|
| Time | `O(n)` |
| Space | `O(min(n, alphabet))` |

## Solution

<!-- prep:solutions:start -->
<details>
<summary><b>Python</b> (spoiler) · <code>0003-longest-substring-without-repeating-characters.py</code></summary>

```python
class Solution:
    def lengthOfLongestSubstring(self, s: str) -> int:
        last = {}
        left = best = 0
        for right, c in enumerate(s):
            if last.get(c, -1) >= left:
                left = last[c] + 1
            last[c] = right
            best = max(best, right - left + 1)
        return best
```

</details>
<!-- prep:solutions:end -->

## Mistakes and edge cases

- shrank one step at a time, then saw the jump
